name: superrack
description: Show and step Waves SuperRack's racks and plug-ins, and switch between its Rack page and overview. Directly over ProLink, as a LAWO mc² console does, with SuperRack's rack names in the dropdowns and feedback on the rack shown; or through Remora, which drives SuperRack over MIDI or ProLink and keeps it following the desk. Not affiliated with Waves.
